title: Unemployment Benefit Claims Training Note: Dependency Allowance Paid in a Part-Week
content:
**How much of the dependency allowance is paid with a weekly payment?** On Unemployment Benefit Claims it follows the week's counted earnings, compared with the disregard, and the week's hours, measured against the full-time hours threshold governing the week.

| Counted earnings | Week's hours | Dependency allowance paid |
|---|---|---|
| Above the disregard | At least 0.2 of the threshold (the part-week fraction) | One half (0.5) of the allowance, rounded to the cent |
| Above the disregard | Below 0.2 of the threshold | Three quarters (0.75) of the allowance, rounded to the cent |
| Not above the disregard | Any | The allowance in full |

**What does the paid allowance enter?** It is the allowance added to the weekly benefit amount before both deductions are subtracted.

**Where is the part-week line?** For a 32-hour threshold, at 6.4 hours; for 34 hours, at 6.8; for 36 hours, at 7.2.

**Hypothetical cases (allowance 15.00, threshold 32).**

| Counted earnings against the disregard | Hours | Allowance paid |
|---|---|---|
| Above | 10.0 | 7.50 |
| Above | 6.0 | 11.25 |
| Not above | 10.0 | 15.00 |
